Crr/1208/2026 Smt. Sushmita Sen & Ors.
Vs. The State of West Bengal & Anr.
Mr. Sourov Mondal, Mr. Arijit Bhuiya, Mr. Rony Mondal, Mr. Bilash Makal, Mr. Debarghyo Sil ...for the petitioners Supplementary affidavit filed by the petitioners is taken on record.

In this application the petitioners have prayed for quashing of the entire proceeding being Special Case No.03 of 2026,
arising out of Complainant Case No.123 of 2024 under Sections 448/509/323/34 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 3 of the Schedule Caste and Schedule Tribe (Prevention of Atrocities)
Act, 1989.

entities.text:
Schedule Caste and Schedule Tribe (Prevention of Atrocities)
Act, 1989
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Being aggrieved by the aforesaid proceeding, learned Counsel for the petitioners submits that primary allegation pertains to an offence under the Schedule Caste and Schedule Tribe (Prevention of Atrocities) Act which cannot be invoked against the petitioners as petitioner nos.1, 2 and 4 are the members of the Schedule Caste.

entities.text: Schedule Caste and Schedule Tribe (Prevention of Atrocities) Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The legislative intent is to protect members of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes from atrocities committed by persons belonging to other communities and not by members of the same community.

He further submits that the allegation made under Section 448 of the IPC are patently absurd and inherently improbable as the petitioner no.1 being the legally weeded wife of opposite party no.2 has every right to reside at her matrimonial home.
The allegation that she along with her family members being the other petitioners had committed house trespass
is inconceivable.
Such an allegation is clearly a product of vindictive imagination.
The allegations under Section 323 of the IPC are equally baseless and such allegations are vague, omnibus and general in nature.
In fact, the matrimonial dispute between the complainant and the petitioner no.1 has tried to be given colour of criminality which is not sustainable in the eye of law.

He further submits that the petitioner no.1 have initiated a criminal proceeding under Sections 498A/406/34 of the IPC read with Sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act against the complainant herein on 03.04.2024.

The present case is the counterblast of the aforesaid proceeding,
and, therefore, further continuance of the impugned proceeding shall be mere abuse of the process of the Court.
Having heard learned Counsel for the petitioners, the application is admitted.

sentences.text: Petitioners are directed to serve a copy of application upon opposite party no.2 through speed post intimating next date of hearing and to file affidavit of service on the returnable date.
Matter be listed in the Monthly List of May, 2026.
Learned Counsel for the petitioners also prays for interim relief.

Having heard learned Counsel for the petitioners and that the petitioners have made out an arguable case, let all further proceeding of Special Case No.03 of 2026 presently pending before learned Additional District & Sessions Judge, 1st Court, Alipore is hereby stayed for a period of 8 weeks or until further order, whichever is earlier.
Parties to act on a server copy of this order duly collected from the official website of the Hon'ble High Court, Calcutta.
( Dr. Ajoy Kumar Mukherjee, J. )
